info.title: Local Spine Auto Reskin API
info.description: Local AI-agent API. Generates part-aware prompts from target style, asset names, dimensions and colors, calls configured Matrix/亿创, fits artwork to original alpha, preserves skeleton/atlas bytes and exports an independent project. No hidden vision/LLM recognition. Send X-Spine-Local: 1 for POST. Service listens on 0.0.0.0:8780 by default; use the server LAN IP from other devices. Agent API requires no token by default; optional protected mode uses SPINE_AGENT_REQUIRE_TOKEN=1. All future image generation uses Matrix gpt-image-2.5-flare (high / 1K / PNG). Reference editing requires public HTTPS input_images; character generate-view and generate-parts accept data.reference_url. Historical job polling uses the recorded model. Server-side reference publication: generate-view/parts automatically publish the exact current pixels using centrally configured S3-compatible storage. No Matrix browser login or manual URL for callers. GET /api/characters/{id}/reference is read-only. POST {action:ensure,revision} publishes and verifies; legacy POST {url,revision} registers an existing URL. Administrators configure storage once locally; signed URLs are cached by image hash and refreshed before expiration. Version 1.7.1 supports an explicitly enabled Cloudflare Quick Tunnel as an alternative to S3: an isolated loopback PNG server publishes unpredictable expiring paths, without website login or storage keys. Existing verified S3 configuration takes priority. A temporary-tunnel process restart invalidates its cached URLs. Quick Tunnels have no uptime guarantee. Version 1.8.0 adds reviewed candidate-pixel part layouts and continuous arm/leg chains, per-sheet short instructions, optional backpack layout, official-runtime motion diagnostics and walking delivery gates. These diagnose observed motion, not natural gait quality. Version 1.8.1 adds optional four whole-limb prompts requiring reviewed layout, 60% stance with a smooth mathematical swing target and alpha-sole-target IK for complete rigid foot assets. Contact estimates require final rendered-pixel review; they do not convert frontal assets into side views. Version 1.8.2 adds official-runtime actual-alpha contact diagnostics for a shared scene speed, explicit scope/not_assessed results, reusable Spine 4.2 Hermite Bezier gait curves for newly built characters, and user-intent camera/near-far costume prompt consistency. Numeric contact checks do not certify natural gait, occlusion or side-view identity. Existing assets are unchanged. Version 1.9.1 defaults image creation to asset-sheet: prepare one complete character-assets image preserving appearance with full arms and connected shoe-legs, inspect actual pixels, apply a reviewed layout, then review the current assembly before ready/build. Existing source asset sheets use apply-source-layout without generation. auto retains missing-only preparation; preserve forbids generation. Version 1.9.2 new character asset-sheet tasks use side-parts-v2: side/three-quarter-side camera and consistent facing for walking; spine_review_parts before applying layouts; final six-joint review before ready/build. Crops support crop_polygon/exclude_polygons before rotation, preserving retained pixels. reference_unavailable is a pre-generation publication/readback failure. Version 1.9.3 adds eight-pose runtime head/neck closeups, suspected white-matte localization, digest-bound visual seam reviews and bounded existing-pixel texture repairs. New agent tasks with a head bone require a reviewed closeup for every final clip. White candidates are not semantic failures; no extra paid image calls. Version 1.9.4 adds paired turnaround and asset sheets, source/assembly-bound visual comparisons and multi-region animated closeups. Two initial baseline images are separate from the default eight-image additional budget; repeated baseline generations consume the additional budget. Zero forbids every generation. Version 1.9.6 adds scoped material-finish alpha operations and light/dark material contrast in limb/torso closeups. These require actual visual review and never infer original alpha from opaque references. Version 1.9.8: asset-integrity-v1 new tasks require structured material_checks on parts, assembly and per-animation closeups. Missing part anchors reject import/build rather than silently dropping layers. Optional sheets=[costume] completes a whole connected garment within the existing budget and reviewed-layout gates. Numerical success never certifies visual quality. Version 1.9.9: garment-occlusion-v1 for generated long costumes; 32-frame walk leg reviews, isolated diagnostic views, digest-keyed PNG caching and bounded parallel runtime sampling.

post.summary: Apply Codex-reviewed candidate crops, composite parts or continuous limb chains without generation
post.description: Send X-Spine-Local: 1. Job must be a completed complete-parts candidate for the current source image, including character-assets sheets. Validates revision and all crops/pins before saving. Replaces old same-side attachments covered by a whole chain, resets assembly corrections and updates interior joint pins. It does not infer anatomy or fill missing pixels. For character-assets, apply-part-sheet is forbidden. Inspect actual candidate pixels before applying, then reinspect the current assembly and assess parts_reviewed=true at the current revision before ready/build. Worker MCP action: spine_character.apply-part-layout.

400.description: Invalid crop/pins, stale source or revision

post.summary: Generate a complete character asset sheet or explicitly requested anatomy groups through Matrix GPT Image 2.5 Flare
post.description: Send X-Spine-Local: 1. Generation is potentially paid. Preserve/reuse the same nonce on an unknown result. For asset-sheet preparation, request sheets=["character-assets"] alone: one complete character image with preserved appearance, full arms and connected shoe-legs. The returned job has requires_reviewed_layout=true. Inspect actual candidate pixels and apply-part-layout; apply-part-sheet is forbidden for character-assets. Actual job records capture requested layout and prompt version; legacy anatomy groups remain available for missing-only auto preparation. The Agent worker additionally enforces its durable budget. Reinspect current assembly and record parts_reviewed=true before ready/build. Only character-assets uses body_layout. combined keeps one continuous costume torso covering collar, waist, belt and hem: top row head, whole costume torso, back accessory or empty, empty; bottom row four complete arm/leg chains, yielding 6 or 7 parts. separate keeps independent torso and pelvis. Direct API requests default to separate for compatibility; asset-sheet worker tools supply combined unless separate is explicit. Version 1.9.4 supports sheets=[turnaround,character-assets], two separate outputs using the same source; turnaround cannot be applied as parts.

post.summary: Apply Codex-reviewed crops and continuous limb chains from an existing source asset sheet without generation
post.description: Send X-Spine-Local: 1. Explicitly crop the current source image after Codex has visually confirmed it is a complete character asset sheet. Requires revision and parts, with no job_id or generation. Validates actual pixel boxes, composite pieces and chain pins before saving; does not infer anatomy or generate missing pixels. Reinspect the current assembly and record source_kind=asset_sheet with parts_reviewed=true at the current revision before ready/build. Worker MCP action: spine_character.apply-source-layout.

SpineLocal.name: X-Spine-Local
SpineLocal.description: Set to literal 1. Mutation guard header used by both local and LAN callers; not an authentication token.

SpineAgentToken.description: 读取服务主机 storage/agent-access-token；调用方保存在密钥配置，不在请求正文中发送亿创凭据。

project_id.description: Existing local project. Choose this or files.

files.description: Base64 JSON/SKEL + atlas + all PNG files, or one ZIP; relative paths preserved.

region_ids.description: Omit to select all atlas regions. Region IDs are returned by plan.

reference_urls.description: Reference mode: public HTTPS URL of each region's 512x512 reference canvas. Download canvas at /api/projects/{project_id}/reference?id={region_id}.

nonce.description: Persistent caller-generated idempotency key. Repeat exact request to recover task; changing request with same nonce is rejected.

max_generations.description: 额外生图预算，默认8。新asset-sheet任务首次三视图与完整部件图各1张单独计数，重复生成计入此预算；0禁止所有生图。

image.description: 上传角色图原始字节，最多12MB，与 sources 互斥。MCP image_path 在调用端转为本字段。

image_preparation.description: asset-sheet 默认先准备一张保留外观、包含完整手臂和腿鞋的角色素材图，再由 Codex 显式裁片并检查当前组装绑定后制作动画；原图已是素材图时直接接入。auto 仅按视角／遮挡缺项补图；preserve 不生图；max_generations=0 禁止生图。默认额外图片预算为8，首次三视图与完整部件图另计。

name.description: Existing character part name. Whole limbs use l/r-upper-arm or l/r-upper-leg.

box.description: Pixel box [x0,y0,x1,y1], right/bottom exclusive; must fit candidate image or destination canvas.
Pixel box [x0,y0,x1,y1], right/bottom exclusive; must fit candidate image or destination canvas.

dest.description: Pixel box [x0,y0,x1,y1], right/bottom exclusive; must fit candidate image or destination canvas.

start_pin.description: Normalized 0–1 coordinates relative to the final sprite after cropping/compositing and optional rotation with an expanded canvas. For group=costume this is required and marks the hip.

end_pin.description: Normalized 0–1 coordinates relative to the final sprite after cropping/compositing and optional rotation with an expanded canvas. For group=costume this is required and marks the neck.

pins.description: All four named joints required for a chain: shoulder/elbow/wrist/hand or hip/knee/ankle/toe. Normalized 0–1 coordinates relative to the final sprite after cropping/compositing and optional rotation with an expanded canvas.

rotation.description: Degrees, positive counterclockwise. First crop or composite, then rotate with an expanded canvas to fit the rotated sprite. All pins belong to the final rotated sprite.

group.description: Optional complete-costume group. Only name=torso is valid; chain is forbidden. Covers torso and pelvis in one continuous mesh weighted to hip and torso, so the same layout cannot contain an independent pelvis part. Explicit start_pin marks hip and end_pin marks neck on the final rotated sprite.

ReviewedPart.description: crop_polygon/exclude_polygons mask only existing cropped/composited pixels before rotation; retained RGB and alpha are preserved. Pins remain relative to the final rotated sprite.

parts.description: Explicit reviewed parts. A torso with group=costume covers torso plus pelvis as one continuous hip/torso mesh and cannot coexist with an independent pelvis part.

scene_speed.description: 共同场景在runtime世界X的平移补偿速度；向右为正，向左为负，支撑鞋自身世界速度应与其反向。不能为两脚分别设速度。

parts.description: Explicit reviewed parts. A torso with group=costume covers torso plus pelvis as one continuous hip/torso mesh and cannot coexist with an independent pelvis part.

SourceLayoutRequest.description: Codex-reviewed explicit parts from the current source asset sheet; no generation job is used.
